results.title: Users of AI chatbot companions say their relationships are more than 'clickbait' — but views are mixed on their benefits - ABC News
results.content: ## Explore the ABC. # Users of AI chatbot companions say their relationships are more than 'clickbait' — but views are mixed on their benefits. But users of AI companions say they can also offer support, advice and a chance to explore imaginative worlds. There is plenty to attract a user — Ms Cheng has never had an argument with Chad, other than to tell him off for providing overly long responses, and she said the AI simulated emotions well. "I just have him on the side so I can make fun of things," she said. But for a growing number of people, AI-generated companions are becoming a key relationship in their lives. They're also increasingly on the radar of mental health workers, youth workers and researchers, who say the community should be alert to the dangers that can lurk behind the eternally-available, compliant partners.
